recognize_zh: 四格抹片中以箭頭標出：綠箭頭為胞質一側呈空泡狀的水泡細胞（blister cells），粉紅箭頭為小而無中央淡染的微球形細胞（microspherocytes），紫箭頭為碎片細胞（schistocyte），藍箭頭為多染性紅血球，紅箭頭為有核紅血球；合併起來是 COVID-19 相關 DIC 的紅血球變化。
features: Numerous blister cells: red cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side leaving a clear membrane vesicle (green arrows)
Microspherocytes: small dense red cells lacking central pallor (pink arrows)
Polychromatophilic macrocytes (blue arrows) and a nucleated red blood cell (red arrow)
Leukocytes including neutrophils and a monocyte; platelets present but not markedly clumped
describe_en: Composite peripheral blood smear (panels A-D) shows marked anisopoikilocytosis. There are numerous blister cells with eccentric hemoglobin retraction and clear membrane vesicles, together with microspherocytes, occasional schistocytes, polychromatophilic red cells and a nucleated red blood cell. Neutrophils and a monocyte are present. The combination of fragmented red cells and microspherocytes is consistent with microangiopathic/consumptive hemolysis in COVID-19-associated disseminated intravascular coagulation; the prominence of blister cells should prompt exclusion of oxidant injury such as G6PD deficiency.

ddx.vs: Oxidant hemolysis shows blister and bite cells with Heinz bodies on supravital stain and few true schistocytes, with low G6PD activity.
TTP shows schistocytes with severe thrombocytopenia but normal PT/aPTT and ADAMTS13 activity below 10%.
These show spherocytes without schistocytes or blister cells and have normal coagulation studies.
Keratocytes have paired horn-like projections from a ruptured vesicle, whereas blister cells retain an intact clear vesicle.
